comment:
* Scroller whose velocity follows the curve of an {@link Interpolator} and
     * is clamped to the interpolated 0f value before starting and the
     * interpolated 1f value after a specified duration.

methods.name: public void start()
methods.comment: * Starts the scroller at the current animation time.

methods.name: public void requestStop()
methods.comment: * Stops the scroller at the current animation time.

methods.name: private float interpolateValue(float value)
methods.comment: * Interpolates the value along a parabolic curve corresponding to the equation * y = -4x * (x-1). * * @param value The value to interpolate, between 0 and 1. * @return the interpolated value, between 0 and 1.

methods.name: public void computeScrollDelta()
methods.comment:
* Computes the current scroll deltas. This usually only be called after
         * starting the scroller with {@link #start()}.
         *
         * @see #getDeltaX()
         * @see #getDeltaY()

methods.name: public void setTargetVelocity(float x, float y)
methods.comment:
* Sets the target velocity for this scroller.
         *
         * @param x The target X velocity in pixels per millisecond.
         * @param y The target Y velocity in pixels per millisecond.

methods.name: public int getDeltaX()
methods.comment:
* The distance traveled in the X-coordinate computed by the last call
         * to {@link #computeScrollDelta()}.

methods.name: public int getDeltaY()
methods.comment:
* The distance traveled in the Y-coordinate computed by the last call
         * to {@link #computeScrollDelta()}.

methodNames: public void setTargetVelocity(float x, float y)
